title: Identity, Not Attributes: analysis code, derived results and verification harness
description:
Analysis code, derived result files, figures and a verification harness for the study Identity, Not Attributes: What Configuration Data Contributes to Incident Prediction in Two Organisations.

The repository measures what configuration data contributes to predicting incident reassignment on two public ITSM event logs (BPI Challenge 2014, Rabobank Group ICT; BPI Challenge 2013, Volvo IT), and reports that the answer is set less by the configuration data than by two decisions that are rarely written down: which layer of the configuration hierarchy is being bought, and which already-recorded fields the comparison baseline is allowed to contain.

What is included. Every analysis script, every derived results/*.csv, the figure generator, the LaTeX source, and scripts/verify_paper.py, which recomputes each of the 325 numeric literals in the manuscript from a result file or from the raw data and fails if any literal in the body is unaccounted for. scripts/attack_verifier.py is that checker's own regression suite: 119 corruptions drawn from defects found in earlier versions of this work. scripts/reproduce_all.py runs the whole thing in dependency order in one command.

What is not included. No row of any dataset. All three event logs are public and are cited by persistent identifier in REPRODUCE.md; none is redistributed here.

What the harness does not do. It guards numbers thoroughly and prose only where a guard was written by hand. The paper reports eight of the author's own errors as results rather than editing them away, and all eight are claims about what a number means -- the checker would have caught none of them. This is stated in the repository and in the paper in the same words.
notes: Analysis code for a manuscript submitted to Information Systems (Elsevier). Once the article has a DOI, add it here with relation 'isSupplementTo' and re-release.
